glosses: traffic (the flow of pedestrians or vehicles in a location)
traffic (commercial transportation or exchange of goods)

examples.text: A ponte está aberta ao tráfego.
examples.en: The bridge is open to traffic.

examples.text: Nessa hora há um tráfego incrível.
examples.en: At this hour, there is incredible traffic.

examples.text: Esse carro está bloqueando o tráfego.
